EVENTS.b: Your auspex finds an ancient gothic warship drifting without power, its hull etched with prayers no one has spoken in ten thousand years.

o.s: Risky. Could hold archeotech, could hold something awake.
+35 credits, no risk.

o.l: Cut out its core with lances
o.s: A clean cut: archeotech and salvage, nothing wakes.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A Hegemony supply tender is limping home with a shattered drive. Its captain is broadcasting on every band.

o.s: Your crews patch their drive. They pay in kind.

o.l: Tow them home with a carrier
o.s: Their captain pays well and owes you a favour: +70 credits, a Nemesis weakness revealed.
+100 credits. Their escort might remember your colours.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Your fleet astropath wakes screaming. She has seen where a relic lies, but reaching it means sailing through a warp-rift.

hegemony.b: Your sensor officer has decoded a ghost signal: an old Navy relic cache, deep inside a hyperspace rift.

corsair.b: Your half-mad navigator swears she can smell treasure on the far side of a rift. She is usually right. Usually.

chorus.b: The brood-mind tastes something ancient and delicious beyond a rift in space.

ithar.b: Your seer dreams of a lost treasure of your people, sleeping beyond a rift.

deathless.b: An old dynastic beacon pulses from beyond a rift. Something of the dynasty is still out there.

o.s: Gain a relic. A random ship takes heavy damage.

o.l: Shield the route with a spare refit
o.s: Gain a relic. A refit from the hold burns out instead of a hull.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A scarred destroyer captain hails you. Her crew has been paid off and she wants a new cause, for a price.

o.s: A destroyer of your own kind, with a veteran captain, joins the fleet.

o.l: Offer her a place in the line, no pay
o.s: She takes the oath. A destroyer of your own kind joins with a veteran captain.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A storm front rolls across your jump route, lightning the colour of old blood.

o.s: Every ship takes 10% hull damage.

o.l: Angle every shield into the front
o.s: No damage, and your captains learn from it: +10 experience each.
Burn fuel and time instead.

EVENTS.b: A lone Ithar vessel matches your course. Its seer offers a trade: one of your refits for one of their treasures.

o.l: Trade a module for a relic
o.s: Lose a random installed module. Gain a relic.
She trades a relic for a song. No refit lost.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A hermit shipwright on an asteroid forge offers to rework one of your hulls. He asks only for the stories of your battles.

o.s: Your most damaged ship is fully repaired and upgraded one Mark.

o.l: Pay him in refits too (one from the hold)
o.s: Your most damaged ship is repaired and upgraded, and a second ship is fully repaired.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Chorus spores have taken a mining moon. Survivors are signalling from the deep shafts, but a brood is gestating.

o.s: Fight an elite Chorus battle. Win a relic.

o.l: Sweep the shafts with point defense
o.s: Rescue the survivors before the brood hatches: +60 credits, +15 experience for every captain.
+20 captain experience for every captain.

EVENTS.b: An orbital shrine to a forgotten saint hangs over a dead world. Your crews ask to make an offering.

hegemony.b: An old orbital shrine hangs over a dead world. Spacers are a superstitious lot, and your crews ask to leave an offering.

corsair.b: An orbital shrine to some forgotten saint hangs over a dead world. Even pirates hedge their bets: your crews ask to leave an offering.

ithar.t: A shrine of the old world
ithar.b: A shrine from before your people’s fall hangs over a dead world. Your crews ask to leave an offering.

o.s: Every ship repairs 30% hull.
Even odds: repair 30%, or nothing.

o.l: Leave one of your relics as an offering
o.s: Every ship is fully repaired and every captain gains 20 experience.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A lifeboat of Hegemony officers begs for asylum. They know how the Navy fights.

o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 60 experience.

o.l: Question them about the enemy commander
o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 30 experience and a Nemesis weakness is revealed.

o.l: Hand them back for the bounty
o.s: +60 credits.

EVENTS.b: A corsair cache hidden in the rings of a gas giant. The locks are primitive.

o.s: Gain a random module.

o.l: Crack it with a torpedo, then strip the fuel
o.s: A refit and the credits.
+45 credits.

EVENTS.b: An abandoned tithe station turns slowly in the dark, its vault still sealed. The alarm circuits look old, but alive.

o.s: +70 credits. The alarm will reach someone: the Nemesis clock moves on.

o.l: Cut the vault open with a lance
o.s: +70 credits, quietly.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A lone life pod drifts across your course. Inside, a fighter pilot clutches the logbook of a wing that no longer exists.

o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 40 experience from her stories.

o.l: Give her a wing on your carrier
o.s: Your best carrier’s wings gain a veteran perk.

o.l: Leave her to the rescue buoys
o.s: Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Engineers report a hairline crack in a reactor housing. It will hold for a battle, perhaps two.

o.s: Your largest ship takes 20% hull damage.

o.l: Rebuild it around a spare refit
o.s: A refit from the hold is used up. No damage.

o.l: Let the living metal knit it
o.s: No cost.

o.l: Buy parts from a passing hauler (45 credits)
o.s: No damage.

EVENTS.b: A wall of ion static rolls toward the fleet. It will scour paint, sensors and anything not shielded.

o.s: Every ship takes 8% hull damage.

o.l: Bring the shields up and push through
o.s: No damage; captains learn from it: +10 experience each.
No damage.

EVENTS.b: A soft-spoken broker hails you from a cloaked yacht. She claims to know the enemy commander who has been shadowing your fleet.

o.s: A Nemesis weakness is revealed.

o.l: Remind her of an old debt
o.s: She pays it in secrets: a Nemesis weakness, free.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.t: A distress call that sounds wrong
EVENTS.b: A freighter screams for help on every band. Your signals officer thinks the voice is a recording.

o.l: Go in loud and take the cargo
o.s: +80 credits, but your next fight starts as an ambush.

o.l: Sweep it with point defense first
o.s: You find the mines and take the cargo: +80 credits.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Thousands of translucent egg-sacs drift between two moons, pulsing in time with something far away.

o.s: +20 experience for every captain.
Gain a damage control refit.
Every ship regrows 30% of its hull.

EVENTS.b: A dying Ithar songship is singing its own lament. The melody carries old star charts in it, for those who can hear.

o.s: Every captain gains 15 experience.
Gain a relic, and the charts show you the enemy commander’s routes: Nemesis clock back one.

o.l: Trade a relic for its archive
o.s: Lose a relic. Reveal a Nemesis weakness and gain 120 credits.

EVENTS.b: A planet of black glass hums under your keels. Deep below, something counts the seconds until it wakes.

o.l: Wake it and take what it guards
o.s: Fight an elite Deathless battle. Win a relic.

o.l: Map it from orbit and leave
o.s: +30 credits for the charts.

EVENTS.b: A tomb-world of your own dynasty, its legions dormant. A word from you would wake one of them.

o.s: A Deathless scythe joins the fleet at full hull.
+60 credits.

EVENTS.b: The crew of one of your ships has gone quiet in the wrong way. Their captain asks for orders.

o.s: The mood lifts.
Your flagship captain loses 20 experience; the fleet falls in line.

o.l: Send your most senior captain to talk
o.s: Free, and that captain gains 15 experience.

EVENTS.b: A slow convoy of ore haulers asks for safe passage through the next system.

o.s: +45 credits from the grateful masters.
Gain a random refit.
+100 credits. Word spreads: the Nemesis clock moves on.

EVENTS.b: Hulls from a war nobody remembers drift in a slow ring, still bristling with unexploded ordnance.

o.s: Gain a random refit. One ship takes 12% hull damage from old mines.
They find the mines: a random refit, no damage.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Long-range scans show a small, fast ship holding exactly at the edge of your sensor range. It carries the enemy commander’s colours.

o.s: Every ship takes 5% hull damage in the chase. Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed.
Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed. No damage.
The Nemesis clock moves on.

EVENTS.b: An officer from the enemy commander’s own fleet surrenders his shuttle to you. He wants asylum and he wants revenge.

o.s: A Nemesis weakness is revealed.
+70 credits. The Nemesis clock moves on.
Your least experienced captain gains 50 experience and a weakness is revealed.

EVENTS.b: An automated drydock still runs on its last power cells. Its arms twitch as your fleet comes alongside.

o.s: Your most damaged ship is fully repaired.
Your most damaged ship is repaired and upgraded one Mark.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A dead star bends the route ahead. A tight slingshot would save fuel, if the hulls can take the stress.

o.s: Every ship takes 5% hull damage; you save 35 credits of fuel.
No damage, and you save the fuel: +35 credits.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A neutral station is auctioning relics recovered from a dead crusade. The bidding is slow and the buyers are armed.

o.s: Gain a relic.

o.l: Trade one of your relics for one of theirs
o.s: Lose a relic, gain a different one and 40 credits.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: Small failures keep happening on one of your ships. Someone aboard is working for the enemy commander.

o.s: A firefight: that ship takes 10% hull damage. A weakness is revealed from his notes.
The defector you questioned named him. Caught quietly: Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed.
The Nemesis clock moves on twice.

EVENTS.b: An old admiral in a ruined hab offers to teach your captains everything she learned, for a price.

o.s: Every captain gains 25 experience.
She teaches for free: every captain gains 25 experience.
Nothing happens.

EVENTS.b: A rock riddled with docking tunnels and gun ports. Half the sector’s stolen goods pass through here.

o.s: Fight an elite Corsair battle. Win a relic.

o.l: Pay them to hide your trail (40 credits)
o.s: Nemesis clock back one.
A Corsair raider joins with a veteran captain.

EVENTS.b: Nothing on the scopes for light-hours in every direction. The crews sleep for the first time in weeks.

o.s: Every ship repairs 10% of its hull.
Every captain gains 10 experience.

beh.d: Raids your path. When his clock fills he takes 25% of your credits (or, if you have under 30 credits, a ship under 25% hull from a fleet of three or more); he holds what he took, and it all comes back to you when he dies. He flees a fight he is losing and comes back richer, with an extra ship each time.

Patient: his clock moves at half speed. He never retreats. Destroyed early, he simply reassembles; destroyed in the last sector, he rises once more for one final fight. When his clock fills, the hunt drains 6% hull from every ship you have (never below 1 hull).

A duelist: he keeps his range, picks off your most damaged ships, and withdraws to fight again once his flagship has no shields left on any side and its hull is under 60%. His fleet is small and elite, and each time he escapes it comes back honed (better shields and aim), never bigger.
Grows from your losses: every ship you lose anywhere makes his fleet 4% tougher (up to 32%). He swarms, and adapts after every meeting, not just every sector.

Methodical: his escorts hold an artillery line around his flagship (their guns lose less aim at range, and they keep close to it), and his fights always bring reinforcements in round 3. He adapts by drilling his formation tighter.

A zealot: his clock moves fast, he never flees, and his flagship charges yours and challenges it to single combat (the two deal 20% more damage to each other; if your flagship falls, he turns on your strongest ship).

flare.warn: The star is flaring. At the start of round {r} every ship on both sides loses its shields for that round.
flare.go: Solar flare! Every shield on the field is down this round.

rout.d: Break their fleet. It flees once it has lost about two thirds of its strength.

ambush.d: Two enemy groups close in from both sides. Break their fleet.

defend.d: Keep enemy ships off the friendly station until round 6 ends. Every enemy ship within 2 hexes of it at the start of a round knocks out 1 integrity. Its batteries fire on enemies that come close.

hunt.d: Their flagship is running and jumps out at the end of round 6. Destroy it before then.

intercept.d: Enemy transports are crossing to the far side (red hexes). Destroy them before they get through.

break.d: Get ships off the far edge: a ship that ends its move on a green hex jumps clear. Their fleet blocks the way ahead and more close in from behind.

hold.d: Have a ship next to the relay, with no enemy there, at the start of 3 rounds.

flagship.d: Destroy their flagship and the rest of their fleet scatters.

hegemony.d: Ships within 3 hexes of their flagship fire as one: a target another synced ship already fired on this round is 6 easier to hit and takes +12% damage. Lose the flagship and sync is gone for the rest of the battle. Does not stack with Anchored Volley.

ithar.d: At the start of its turn, a shield facing that was not hit since its last turn recharges to full, and a facing that was hit recharges twice. Ithar hulls cannot Brace.

chorus.d: When an enemy ship dies, the Chorus ship that killed it regrows 12% of its hull and every other Chorus ship within 2 hexes regrows 6%, up to 15% per ship each round.

deathless.d: The first Deathless ship to fall each battle (never the flagship) reassembles at the start of the next round with 35% hull and cannot fire that round; a fleet of 6 or more gets two returns. Funeral Pyre stops it.

corsair.d: Corsairs field no lance weapons, and their rocket pods fire salvos that point defense can thin.

voidsworn.d: Broadsides hit harder after a hard burn (drive rule); carriers cost 25% more.

cut.w: cut in two by a lance

tidal.w: torn apart by the dead star

vex.d: Every ship fires a free volley at the best target its guns can reach, right now.

malek.d: Torpedoes reload at once and every ship deals +30% damage this round.

ashgrove.d: Every carrier launches a wing, then all squadrons strike again at once with +50% damage this round.

thale.d: All shields refill and your ships take 40% less hull damage this round.

tables.CMD_HOLD: Once per battle. Each round you hold it, it gets stronger (full power from round 3), and losing a ship charges it a level at once. Hold too long and the fight may be over.
